author: PavelMakarchuk
body: Resolved on PE-US 1.705.16. PE now returns MT siitax = $940.14, matching TaxAct's MT Form 2 line 13 = $940 (sum of Schedule II line 11 cap-gains tax $409 + ordinary tax line 12 $531). The double-subtraction bug in `mt_capital_gains_tax_joint` is fixed via PolicyEngine/policyengine-us#8344 (merged).
